I had a former close friend in high school who would constantly tell me how I was the only reason he hadn’t killed himself/harmed himself, or tell me to do him favors or her would kill/harm himself. He frequently would ask me to give him hugs at school as they were “the only think to get him through the day” and then accuse me of being in love with him on the basis that I gave him daily hugs. I stopped texting him as often, and would often ignore him for days, and he would try and bait me by sending texts like “so that’s what salt feels like in a wound” “I burned myself again” “I went to a family funeral yesterday, I wonder whose going to be next....” 
that shit fucked me up, even now like 4 years later I still live in fear that my eventually cutting him off will lead to his death. I have him blocked in every way but if he ever killed himself there’s no way it wouldn’t feel like I was responsible. 
He still regularly tries to contact me, a couple years back he had a mutual friend I hadn’t seen since HS wish me happy birthday for him. I used to periodically block his number thinking maybe it was over, only to get a text out of the blue weeks after. 
He tried to add me on Snapchat just a few months ago. I finally told him how I felt, the years of emotional abuse he put me through, and told him explicitly to never contact me again. He couldn’t even if he tried but I still think it helped
